method: Prospective normal approximations and fixed-parameter sensitivity grid for paired binary/continuous endpoints; binding migration treated as a conjunctive binary endpoint. No empirical #110 observations.

frozen_proposal.assessment: not justified: only 2 pairs/cell and unknown nuisance parameters

primary_cohort_requirement: Do not freeze a count yet. Obtain outcome-blind external/pilot nuisance bounds. If moderate regime is defensible, 128 templates/256 executions is the smallest candidate for primary migration; 64/128 is not robust to conservative variance/attrition.
interaction_external_validity_requiremen: At least 288 templates/576 executions is the current candidate; 512/1024 for conservative interaction precision. This is distinct from primary support.
decision: D: available information is insufficient to freeze sample size; amendment replaces asserted 64 with a blinded variance-calibration gate and prospective recalculation.
not_cheapest_warning: No design selected merely on cost; scientific conjunction and interactions remain unchanged.
